topic: Should the Death Penalty Be Legal?

turns.speaker: 303.0_con
turns.text: The death penalty provides a quick and painless approach for punishment of severe crimes and criminals. Should murders, rapists and other violent criminals really be given a quick way out of their crimes? What if these criminals had intended to kill themselves and thought they may as well act out anyway, as they will either be killed or given the death penalty and no longer have to deal with the struggles of life. These criminals should have be stripped of their freedom but given time to dwell on their acts for life and in the containment of prison. There should be no quick way out for them and perhaps they will eventually come to regret what they committed.
